name: AlphaBox
description: Autonomous crypto market intelligence & policy-bounded trading plugin for AI agents in PayBox
author: AlphaBox Team

auth.description: Machine-to-machine HTTP 402 micro-payments in USDC on Solana or Base

tools.name: get_market_signal
tools.description: Query real-time DEX liquidity, volume, buy/sell momentum, and 0-100 conviction score for any Solana or Base token via x402 payment.

token.description: Contract address or SPL mint of the target token (e.g. Solana USDC or Base WETH)

tools.name: execute_scoped_trade
tools.description: Execute a policy-bounded swap order on behalf of the user through PayBox's non-custodial credential vault. Trades <= $25 execute autonomously; larger trades escalate to passkey approval.

amountUsd.description: Amount in USD to trade (default limit: $25)
